lines.text: “I relieved his shoulder of the burden;
his hands were freed from the basket.
You called out in distress, and I rescued you;
I answered you from the cloud of thunder;
I tested you at the waters of Meribah.
Hear, O My people, and I will warn you:
O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
There must be no strange god among you,
nor shall you bow to a foreign god.
I am the LORD your God,
who brought you up out of Egypt.

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, Les casseurs de pierres — the two bent under the stone and the basket all day long, I relieved his shoulder of the burden, his hands were freed from the basket
pictures.name: pd_courbet_casseurs_pierres

pictures.scene: Martin Johnson Heade, Approaching Thunderstorm — the black sky standing over the water before it breaks, you called out in distress and I rescued you, I answered you from the cloud of thunder
pictures.name: pd_heade_approaching_thunderstorm

pictures.scene: Thomas Fearnley, Labrofossen — the whole force of the water coming down over the rock, I tested you at the waters of Meribah
pictures.name: pd_fearnley_labrofossen

pictures.scene: Albert Anker, Der Gemeindeschreiber — the man reading out what is written for the people to hear, hear O My people and I will warn you, O Israel if only you would listen to Me
pictures.name: pd_anker_gemeindeschreiber

pictures.scene: Ary Scheffer, La Tentation du Christ — the Lord turning away from the one who offers Him another master, there must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god
pictures.name: pd_scheffer_tentation

pictures.scene: David Roberts, The Israelites Leaving Egypt — the whole people streaming out from under the temples and the idols of Egypt on the morning they are let go, I am the LORD your God who brought you up out of Egypt
pictures.name: pd_roberts_uittocht

pictures.scene: Jean-Francois Millet, La becquee — the mother feeding the small ones who sit with their mouths open on the step, open wide your mouth and I will fill it
pictures.name: pd_millet_la_becquee
